title: Causal Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement with Mamba
description: Six-person Bristol coursework on causal audio-visual speech enhancement with a Mamba backbone.
reportTitle: Trust is All You Need: Real-Time Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement with Reliability-Aware Causal Mamba
institution: School of Electrical, Electronic, and Mechanical Engineering · University of Bristol
body: The project built a real-time audio-visual speech enhancement system on a causal Mamba backbone and tested it under noisy and disrupted visual input. According to the report's work allocation, my parts were the visual confidence estimator, the Scout lookahead design, the AudioNeed amplifier and its later removal, and the multi-task loss. I also worked on the multiplicative fusion cascade, the three-channel cocktail-party mixing protocol, the bug audit, the configuration ablations and the per-SNR contribution experiment. In addition, I integrated all components into one system. The report was not peer reviewed, and its results belong to all six authors.
